cutoffs.comparisons: T0 history includes created <= T0 AND updated <= T0; targets use open-left, closed-right horizons.

sources.accounts: The fusion_fit, selection, and confirmation rosters already reserved by experiments_v4/split; random-holdout target files are not used for this supplement.
sources.accepted_reviews: split_v1/train/review_lineage.parquet joined by exact user, App ID, review ID, and label to valid_raw in the audited Kieran DuckDB cache.
sources.training: Reuse the audited temporal_cutoff2022 accepted positive-pair artifact only if its source, protocol, code, output-file hashes and row counts verify; otherwise derive from accepted train lineage joined to valid_raw.
sources.catalog: Keep the fixed 37,610 input App IDs and 6,630 Linux candidate App IDs; score arrays retain the complete shapes and apply an availability mask.

release_dates.availability: A Linux candidate is available only when its current parsed release_date is known and <= 2022-12-31. Unknown and later dates are masked; no candidate is dropped from the saved 6,630-item arrays.

sources.metadata_limit: Current Linux support and metadata do not reconstruct historical platform support, releases, or metadata versions.

training.cutoff: Use accepted positive TRAIN review pairs with timestamp_created and timestamp_updated both non-null and <= T0, within the fixed input catalog.
training.v4_exclusion: Remove every v4 reserved account (fusion_fit, selection, and confirmation) from the temporal training pairs before any fresh fit.
training.freshness_limit: The reserved accounts were part of historical v1-v3 training data; this is a new account-disjoint v4 refit, not an untouched historical development set.

cohorts.history: Accepted review pairs in the same reserved role account whose created and updated timestamps are both known and <= T0; positives and negatives are visible. Deduplicate to one account/App pair.
cohorts.target: One positive current-Linux candidate per account, uniformly sampled without replacement from distinct eligible Apps released by T0 and absent from that account's T0 history.

confirmation.scoring: Do not score or inspect confirmation outcomes until the separate selection lock names frozen finalists.

cohorts.minimum_history: No minimum history is used to select a temporal cohort; target-eligible accounts with zero or short T0 histories remain in the cohort. Report 1-2, 3-4, 5+ input groups and zero-input counts separately.
cohorts.sampling: SHA256 counter-mode rejection sampling over ascending eligible App IDs; namespace=steam-temporal-v4-hidden-positive-linux; seed=20261108; exact uint64 user key and temporal role.

reporting.primary_population: T0 histories with at least 5 remaining input games and at least 1 positive; align the v4 primary population.
reporting.supplemental_population: All target-eligible accounts; show 1-2, 3-4, 5+, zero-input, and zero-positive-input groups separately. Do not pool the deliberately stratified v4 role samples as a natural population.
reporting.metrics: Use the already frozen v4 ranking and uncertainty rules; this protocol fixes temporal data construction and availability only.

limitations: The experiment controls accepted interaction creation and update timestamps but does not reconstruct historical catalog, metadata, Linux support, or recommendation impressions.
Candidate availability is approximated with a current 2025 release-date snapshot; unknown release dates are excluded conservatively.
Current Linux candidate flags may reflect changes after T0; they are retained because historical platform support is unavailable.
The reserved v4 accounts were included in historical v1-v3 training and development, so the temporal confirmation is not a pristine never-seen test.
Confirmation target files are materialized for a later locked evaluation and are not scored by this builder.
